run_f_gold: run f_gold to count contiguous subsequences of a digit list whose digits recursively add to 9
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple digit list inputs and compare results with f_filled
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses prefix sum modulo 9 and a frequency array to count valid subsequences
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold algorithm that finds contiguous subsequences divisible by 9 in a number string
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases like all-zero inputs and non-digit characters gracefully
